meta.title: FGV Quant Capital — simulated fund
meta.description: FGV Quant Capital is the league's simulated portfolio: a fictional, educational fund for practising portfolio construction and risk management.

Capital.title: A simulated portfolio, to learn by doing
Capital.description: FGV Quant Capital is the league's simulated portfolio. It is not a real fund: members use it to practise, with method and accountability, what they study.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.simulated: Simulated fund, for educational purposes only. It is not a real investment fund.
disclaimer.noMoney: No real money is involved: nothing here raises, manages or receives third-party funds.
disclaimer.past: Past (simulated) performance is not an indication of future results.
disclaimer.advice: Nothing on this site constitutes investment advice.

how.title: A practice lab
how.description: FGV Quant Capital exists so members can exercise, in a simulated setting, the full cycle of portfolio management.

construction.title: Portfolio construction
construction.body: Practising building a portfolio from what is learned in quantitative research.

risk.title: Risk management
